def test_reference():
    exec("import itertools,random
from web_api.config.configreader import ConfigReader

def reference(text):
 out=[]
 for service in text.split(':'):
  fields={}
  for raw in service.split(','):
   pair=raw.split('=')
   if len(pair)==2:
    key,value=(part.strip() for part in pair)
    if key in ('pin','port','ledCount'):fields[key]=value
  if all(fields.get(k) for k in ('pin','port','ledCount')):
   out.append(tuple(fields[k] for k in ('pin','port','ledCount')))
 return out or [('18','9000','10')]

def check(text):
 ConfigReader.initConfigs(text)
 actual=[(v.pin,v.port,v.ledCount) for v in ConfigReader.configs]
 assert actual==reference(text),(text,actual,reference(text))
 assert all(type(v) is str for row in actual for v in row)
 return actual

cases=['','pin=21,port=9001,ledCount=30',' pin = 21 , port = 9001 , ledCount = 30 ',
 'pin=,port=9001,ledCount=30','pin=21,port=,ledCount=30','pin=21,port=9001,ledCount= ',
 'pin=21,port=9001,ledCount=30:pin=22,port=9002,ledCount=40',
 'pin=,port=9000,ledCount=30:pin=22,port=9002,ledCount=40',
 'pin=21,port=9001,ledCount=30,pin=','pin=,pin=21,port=9001,ledCount=30',
 'pin=21,port=9001,ledCount=30,unknown=x,broken=x=y']
for case in cases:check(case)
rng=random.Random(4601)
spaces=['',' ','\t','\n','  ']
for _ in range(600):
 services=[]
 for _ in range(rng.randrange(1,5)):
  fields=[]
  for key in rng.sample(['pin','port','ledCount','unknown'],4):
   value=rng.choice(['',' ',str(rng.randrange(1,10000)),'custom'])
   fields.append(rng.choice(spaces)+key+rng.choice(spaces)+'='+rng.choice(spaces)+value+rng.choice(spaces))
  services.append(','.join(fields))
 check(':'.join(services))
# A later parse replaces the previous list instead of accumulating or leaking entries.
check('pin=21,port=9001,ledCount=30');check('');check('pin=22,port=9002,ledCount=40')
print('config-reference-ok')
", {})
